description: This script generates C++ code for overlay widgets based on a JSON configuration file, used in the ANGLE project for rendering overlays.

classes.name: OverlayWidget
classes.description: Represents an overlay widget with properties parsed from JSON, including type, constructor, color, coordinates, and description for graphs.

methods.name: extract_type_and_constructor
methods.description: Extracts the widget type and constructor string from properties.

methods.name: get_font_size_constant
methods.description: Returns the font size constant based on font property.

methods.name: is_graph_type
methods.description: Checks if the widget type is a graph or histogram.

methods.name: is_text_type
methods.description: Checks if the widget type is not a graph, implying it's text.

methods.name: is_negative_coord
methods.description: Determines if a coordinate is negative or refers to another widget's edge.

methods.name: set_alignment_flags
methods.description: Sets alignment flags for widget positioning based on coordinates.

methods.name: get_offset_helper
methods.description: Calculates offset and alignment for widget positioning.

methods.name: get_bounding_box_coords
methods.description: Calculates bounding box coordinates based on offset and alignment.

methods.name: generate_widget_init_helper
methods.description: Generates code for widget initialization with position, size, and color.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to read JSON layout, generate overlay widget code, and write to output file.
